scripts.preview:yt: node build.mjs && cd yt && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.98 preview
scripts.preview:tiktok: node build.mjs && cd tiktok && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.98 preview
scripts.check: node build.mjs && cd yt && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.98 check && cd ../tiktok && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.98 check
scripts.render:yt: node build.mjs && cd yt && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.98 render -o renders/pumpkin-launcher-yt-16x9.mp4
scripts.render:tiktok: node build.mjs && cd tiktok && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.98 render -o renders/pumpkin-launcher-tiktok-9x16.mp4
scripts.render: npm run render:yt && npm run render:tiktok
